task: a2a-leakcheck verdicts on known leaks (real labels) and known non-leaks (permuted labels, audit_null)
method: Full-data verdicts on the real labels, and runtime and memory, from `python -m a2a_leakcheck run --strip` in a fresh process per arm and view. Permuted labels, baselines and subsamples go through the same verdict rule (a2a_leakcheck.analyze: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold by prompt group, macro-F1 with a 1000-resample cluster-bootstrap 95% CI, LEAK above chance + 0.05, 99-permutation test with the rf-light null at alpha 0.05, at least 20 samples per class in 5 groups), without feature attribution, which the verdict does not use. Own connections only. Ports are never features.

methods.leakcheck: a2a-leakcheck: GBT on the header-only features (195 per trace, 35 per agent)
methods.kfp_rf: k-FP features (138, direction and timing only) with the tool's RF
methods.first_request: first-request size alone with GBT (in TCP sequence space, features/first_request.py first_request_seq; role: bytes the agent receives)

audit_null.reason: CI upper bound 0.277 <= chance + margin 0.300, but the permutation test finds a signal (p = 0.030 <= 0.05): the two models disagree

leakcheck.reason: CI upper bound 0.277 <= chance + margin 0.300, but the permutation test finds a signal (p = 0.030 <= 0.05): the two models disagree

reference.definition: Known leaks: escalated and cloud_role by construction, in every cell, and the cells (arm, view, attribute) in which k-FP or the first-request rule reads LEAK on the full data; a2a-leakcheck is not part of the reference, and recall is measured against these cells. Known non-leaks: audit_null and the permuted labels. A cell in neither set is not scored. Agreement with a2a-leakcheck's own full-data verdicts is reported apart, as coverage, and the cells only a2a-leakcheck flags are listed as beyond the baselines.
